name: list_files
description: List files in the workspace. /home is your own synced space; /repos/<name> are git clones.

name: read_file
description: Read lines of a text file from the workspace, with line numbers. Long files come in parts: use grep to find the lines you need, then read just that range.

name: grep
description: Search files for a word or regular expression. Returns matching lines as path:line: text. Use it to find where something is before reading.

pattern.description: Text or regular expression, e.g. "function send" or "TODO|FIXME"

path.description: Folder or file to search, e.g. /repos/app or /repos/app/src (default /home)

skip.description: Skip this many matches (to get the next page)

name: note
description: Your notepad for this chat. Save what matters for the task (findings, file locations, decisions, next steps) so you don't need old tool output again; update or delete notes as they stop being relevant. Your notes are always shown to you.

action.description: add a note, update one by id, or delete one by id

text.description: Note text (for add/update); keep it short

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a text file in the workspace. Files under /home sync to all the user's devices.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file (or folder) in the workspace.

name: github_list_repos
description: List the GitHub repos the user has given Squiggle access to.

name: git_clone
description: Clone a GitHub repo into /repos/<name>. Pulls if it is already cloned.

branch.description: Branch to check out (default: the repo default)

name: git_status
description: Show the current branch and changed files of a cloned repo.

name: git_branch
description: Switch to a branch, or start a new one. Pass an existing branch name (e.g. "main") to switch to it. A new branch gets the "agent/" prefix; you can push agent/ branches freely, while pushing any other branch asks the user first. Uncommitted changes carry over to a new branch.

name.description: Existing branch, or a short name for a new one, e.g. "fix-login"

from.description: For a new branch: branch or commit to start from (default: current)

name: git_commit
description: Commit all changes in a repo on the current branch.

name: git_push
description: Push the current branch to GitHub (never forced). agent/ branches push right away; any other branch (like main) asks the user for permission first.

name: git_pull
description: Fetch and fast-forward the current branch from GitHub.

name: git_log
description: Recent commits on the current branch.

name: github_open_pr
description: Open a pull request from the current (pushed) branch.

name: fetch_url
description: Read a web page by its full URL. Returns readable text. Not a search engine.

name: web_search
description: Search the web (DuckDuckGo). Returns a short summary when one exists, plus titles, links and snippets. To read a result in full, pass its url to fetch_url.

name: remember
description: Save a lasting fact about the user or their projects (preferences, decisions, names, how things work). Saved as subject → relation → object.

name: recall
description: Search saved memory facts.

name: forget
description: Delete a saved memory fact by id (when the user says it is wrong or outdated).

name: search_history
description: Search the user's past conversations (all sessions) for something discussed before.

name: calculate
description: Calculate a math expression exactly: + - * / ^, parentheses, percentages (15% of 240), and sqrt, round(x, digits), min, max, abs, floor, ceil, pow, log, ln, exp. Use it for every sum, price, percentage or conversion; never do math in your head.

name: run_js
description: Run JavaScript in an isolated sandbox (no access to the user's data or files). Use for code, data processing, or checking logic, not for plain math (use calculate). Use console.log or return a value. Top-level await works.
